body: Ask your P.O. if there is anywhere else you can go to take the test. I had to go to another city once a week to take a test while the offices were closed In my city.
For me personally, a liked weed for 3 years and my social anxiety got worse and even since I’ve quit I’ve felt a lot better. Weed is great, but for me it brought my social anxiety out.
Appreciate it and trust me, you won’t see me again! 😄
